applies_to: ONICON F-4600 inline ultrasonic flow meters with LCD and the BACnet MS/TP output.
summary: The F-4600 is an inline ultrasonic flow meter. Its BACnet object list keeps the energy objects of ONICON's BTU meters but marks them not used; the meter fills in flow rate, fluid temperature, signal diagnostics, volume totals and pulse input totals. It talks BACnet MS/TP or Modbus on an RS485 port.
notes: Objects marked "(Not used)" in the manual are kept in the list with that note; they belong to the shared BTU meter layout.
Names are the dual mode function text from the manual; Object_Name itself is not printed. The description gives the single mode meaning.
The protocol statement and device Object_List say AV 1-22, but the analog value table prints AV 1-24; all printed rows are listed.
Units are factory defaults: flow gpm, l/s, ft3/m or m3/h; volume gallons, liters, ft3 or m3; temperature °F or °C; speed of sound ft/s or m/s. Energy units are listed as not available.
There is no per-object read/write column. The reset BVs are marked W because writing 1 resets the total.

source.title: F-4600 with LCD Flow Meter Manual

integration.summary: Read AI 2 for flow rate and AV 9 for the volume total, plus AI 3 if the fluid temperature is useful. Map AI 7 Signal quality and MV 1 Meter Status for diagnostics. Skip the objects marked not used.

minimum_points.name: Supply internal temperature
minimum_points.why: Fluid temperature measured by the meter

setup: BACnet MS/TP on terminal block TB4, 2-wire half duplex, 1/4 unit load.
MAC address 1-255, default 17. Device instance default 57017.
Baud 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800; default 38400. 120 ohm termination optional, default off; no biasing.
Protocol, address, instance and baud are set in the meter's commissioning menu.
gotchas: The energy-related objects exist but hold no data on the F-4600.
Auxiliary pulse inputs (AV 15-17) depend on the I/O option in the model number.
